title: Probe toggle dashboard UX notes
body:
Purpose:
Short working notes for a lightweight dashboard UI + metric set to let operators flip observability probes on/off per-tenant and preview expected cost/trace volume impact. Idea is to give oncall and SRE a low-friction control surface for temporarily muting noisy probes, enabling extra sampling for investigations, and understanding the downstream dashboard/alert consequences.

TL;DR:
- Add per-tenant probe toggle panel (sticky header) with: state, last-changed, estimated QPS/trace delta, quick revert, and audit link.
- Expose a minimal metric set to drive the UI and SLOs: probe_fires, probe_disabled_count, probe_error_rate, probe_sampled_trace_rate, probe_cost_estimate_usd.
- Trace tag convention: probe_id, probe_mode, sample_reason, tenant_id, session_hint.
- Sampling policy: adaptive by tenant weight + manual override via toggle.

Why this now:
- We keep getting pages driven by high-cardinality probes from a handful of tenants; operators frequently ask for a way to mute specific probes without touching instrumentation code.
- Current rollout work (ENG-1423) exposes toggles in config but no operator-friendly surface or cost estimates.

Proposed metrics (names + short defs) to instrument and wire to dashboard: 
- probe.fires.count: cumulative counter incremented each time a probe evaluates true (label: probe_id, tenant_id, route).
- probe.disabled.count: counter incremented when a probe is toggled off for a tenant (label: probe_id, tenant_id, actor).
- probe.error.count: counter for probe evaluation failures (label: probe_id, tenant_id, error_class).
- probe.sampled_traces.count: traces generated due to this probe firing and chosen by sampler (label: probe_id, tenant_id, sampling_reason).
- probe.kv_warmth.histogram: small histogram bucketed by TTL categories for cached probes (label: probe_id, tenant_id).
- probe.cost.estimated_usd.gauge: short-term estimate of trace storage + query cost delta if probe enabled (label: probe_id, tenant_id, window=1h).
- probe.latency.p95_ms: p95 probe evaluation time (important for hot paths).

Metric semantics / guardrails:
- Counters should be monotonically increasing; dashboards compute rates using increase().
- Cost gauge is approximate and best-effort — update cadence = 5m. Include a disclaimer in UI.
- High-cardinality labels: avoid free-text request ids. Keep label set to {probe_id, tenant_id, route, sampling_reason}.

Trace tagging convention (minimal, consistent):
- trace.tags.probe_id = <short-id>
- trace.tags.probe_mode = {on|off|override-on|override-off} // indicates toggle state at request time
- trace.tags.sampling_reason = {probe, synthetic-probe, manual-debug, canary} 
- trace.tags.tenant_id = <tenant-short> (for analytics only; must obey PII rules)
- trace.tags.session_hint = <coarse-bucket> (e.g., page, api, background)

Dashboard UX sketch (operator flows):
1) Landing panel: list of probes (filterable) + per-tenant column. Quick state chip (green/yellow/red) and small sparkline for probe.fires rate.
2) Drill panel: shows metric definitions, last 24h fire count, sampled_traces, cost_estimate, and recent traces (linked to trace viewer).
3) Toggle action: toggle on/off with a small modal that requires reason + expected duration (auto-revert option). Toggling writes audit entry and increments probe.disabled.count.
4) Safety: toggles limited by role-based access. If a toggle would increase cost > X% for org, show warning and require 2-step confirmation.
5) Revert: quick revert button with timeline view (who toggled, when, why).

Sampling strategy and implementation notes:
- Default: low baseline sampling for all probes (1-5percent) to keep visibility.
- Adaptive bump: if probe fires spike > 10x baseline for a tenant, temporarily bump sampling for that tenant up to a configurable cap (e.g., 20%) for 10 minutes, then decay.
- Manual override: toggle "override-on" forces sampling rate to a higher fixed value (e.g., 50%) and sets probe_mode tag.
- Sampler must be able to honor per-tenant and per-probe state; prefer central decision point in gateway layer.

Dashboard cost estimate approach:
- Leverage probe.sampled_traces.count * avg_trace_size_bytes * storage_cost_usd_per_byte + query_estimate (based on typical dashboard query frequency).
- Use recent-window extrapolation (5m rolling). Present as band (low/likely/high).

Operational runbooks (short):
- Noisy probe: toggle off for tenant (record reason), watch application errors for 30m, then escalate to instrument owners.
- Investigating spike: toggle override-on for tenant + enable higher sampling, capture traces, then revert.
- Suspected bug: enable for small test tenant only (use "test-tenant" filter) and run smoke harness.

Data governance / privacy notes:
- Tenant-level identifiers must be hashed or short-form; never include PII in trace tags.
- For regulated tenants that opted out of tracing, toggles should be disabled.

Rollout plan (phased):
- Phase 0 (2w): prototype UI wireframe + metrics plumbing for 10 probes in staging.
- Phase 1 (4w): expose 5 pilot tenants in prod behind feature flag; instrumentation owners opt-in probes.
- Phase 2 (2w): add cost warnings and role gating.
- Phase 3: GA with audit logging and retention policy updates.

Open questions / trade-offs:
- Who owns the canonical mapping probe_id -> human name? (proposal: instrumentation owners maintain a single YAML in repo and register via CI).
- How to quota toggle actions during incidents to avoid churn? (rate-limit toggle API and record rationale).
- Cost estimate accuracy vs complexity: do we accept ~20% error for speed? I think yes initially.

Next steps (action items):
- Marcus: mockup quick wireframes (due 2026-02-18).
- Evan: add probe.* metrics to the collector prototype (ENG-2147) and land in staging (due 2026-02-20).
- Asha: create Confluence page with final metric contract and link to audit schema (due 2026-02-22).

Notes / references:
- Related tickets: JIRA OBS-2147 (toggle backend), OBS-2190 (sampler changes).
- Slack thread: #ops-probes "proposal: probe toggles" (pinged @observability).
